card.name: Numbers and links in clotting contexts
card.fires_on: Small pieces like a digit, a space before a number, or a linking word such as "such" or "within". They appear in blood-clotting text about platelets, heparin, bleeding or factor VIII, just before a number or example is given.

modes.label: Digits and spaces before values
modes.description: The marked piece is a digit, a space or a comparison sign leading into a number in a platelet count, clotting time or hemostasis threshold.

modes.label: Linking words in clotting text
modes.description: A linking word or bracket in sentences on platelets, antiplatelet drugs or purpura.
modes.example: concomitant medications,<< such>> as esomeprazole, that inhibit

card.writes: It suppresses blood-related words (blood, heartbeat, vascular), so it seems to stop the model from simply naming blood as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on numbers and joining words in clotting and platelet passages, where the next word is not likely to be "blood".
